blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA— Tyrese Maxey scored 27 points, Joel Embiid had 20 and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Toronto Raptors 123-112 in the NBA on Thursday night while playing without LeBron James. James (back) was ruled out earlier Thursday, missing his third game of the season. READ: NBA: Tyrese Maxey leads 76ers’ comeback win over Pacers Jaylen Brown added 18 points for Philadelphia, which improved to 10-3. The 76ers rebounded from Tuesday’s 123-101 loss to Jayson Tatum and the Celtics in Brown’s first game against his former team.
